fusions.name: Shriek from the Hollow
fusions.desc: A shriek rings through your hollow trunk and deals 7 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, leaving them [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Roost Drop
fusions.desc: Lets go of a high branch and falls on a target up to 7 tiles away. The blow deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Dusk Emergence
fusions.desc: Looses the colony that roosts inside your trunk for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage. Each kill made while it flies restores 2 health to you.

fusions.name: Hangs by Night
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
